description: Memory-model soundness guards: each function is a way a user could otherwise feed the JIT a wrong-typed value (covariant write-through, map any-alias, cast laundering, missing required fields, float floor-division, return-operator typing, gmatch any, empty-literal absent field, multi-assign under-supply, fresh-value escape, interprocedural mutation vs guard narrowing, non-nil assertion on a provably-nil value, covariant record alias widening across cast/reassign/field-store/index-store/sub-object exposure sites). Each is pinned with expect-error.
